This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and a [[Thuwisten]] of the [[Tyia]] philosophy.

==Biography==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Tyia masters on [[Revyia]] were highly disturbed by the deaths of so many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which they could sense through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] prompted them to call a meeting within a [[Revyia temple|temple]] grown from the largest [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on their world. They then charged their most capable students, including this individual, with seeking out any surviving Jedi in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and aiding them in whatever way possible.

This Tyia adept sought out and consulted with a Human Jedi.<ref name="Jedi Academy">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>
